# MeetMap Automated Character + Voice Swap · V5

**Source:** Google Drive → MeetMap TikTok Content → Queue

V5 upgrades:
- Native SCAIL-2 multi-reference: FLUX-generated primary when available; otherwise exact source first frame + face_front + face_angle + upper_body.
- Optional SCAIL-2 Relighting LoRA at strength 1.0; missing/corrupt relighting automatically falls back to the base SCAIL model.
- Automatic long-video segmentation: 81-frame chunks, 5-frame overlap, 76-frame stride, deterministic overlap removal after rendering.
- Full source processing up to 2401 frames; no longer hard-capped to one 81-frame segment.
- Visual models are forcibly unloaded before Seed-VC starts, reducing peak VRAM.
- Fixed creator_01 Seed-VC voice uses 3-stage decoding; Seed-VC retries once and can fall back to original source audio.
- Final export uses multi-codec/container fallbacks. Drive finalization is fail-soft and runs only after a saved output exists.

Optional stages degrade with warnings. Only missing core input/base-model/output-write conditions can stop the run. Drive-finalization failures never invalidate an already saved video.

widgets_values: A realistic video of the replacement character naturally performing the exact motion from the source clip in the same environment. Preserve the character identity, hairstyle, facial structure and visible outfit from the generated first-frame reference. Match the source lighting, shadows, camera perspective, nearby objects and interactions. Photorealistic skin, stable face, coherent body anatomy, natural hands, no identity drift.
nodes.title: 7 · FINAL VIDEO DESCRIPTION

widgets_values:
Image 1 is the exact first frame of the target video crop and defines the scene, camera, pose, body position, expression, hands, objects and background. Images 2 and onward are identity references of the same replacement character.

Replace only the person in Image 1 with the character shown in Images 2+. Preserve the exact pose, body position, gaze direction, gesture, framing, camera perspective, background, furniture, nearby objects and object interactions from Image 1. Preserve the replacement character's facial identity, age, hairstyle, hairline, body proportions and recognizable appearance from the identity references. Adapt the replacement character naturally to the source lighting, shadows, white balance and exposure. Keep realistic skin texture, pores, fine hair and smartphone-camera imperfections.

The result must look like the same real frame was filmed with the replacement character already present. Do not redesign the environment. Do not change the camera angle. Do not change the pose. Do not move objects. No beauty filter, no plastic skin, no CGI look, no extra limbs, no identity blending between source person and replacement character.

widgets_values:
## V5 automation rules

**Multi-reference:** SCAIL receives the generated character-swapped start frame as primary reference plus face_front.png, face_angle.png and upper_body.png as additional views.

**Relighting:** the official zai-org/SCAIL-2 relighting LoRA is converted to ComfyUI safetensors during installation and applied after DPO, before optional LightX2V distillation.

**Long videos:** the complete requested source is normalized to 4n+1 and split automatically into 81-frame segments with 5-frame overlap. Each segment uses the corresponding source-motion window; the repeated overlap is dropped during final stitch. A hard max of 32 segments prevents unexpectedly expensive jobs.

**VRAM:** the audio branch waits on the fully composited visual output. ComfyUI unloads visual models and clears caches before Seed-VC is allowed to load.

**Finalization:** only after final SaveVideo succeeds is the Drive source moved from Queue to Already posted and marked processed.
